title: Guess the Word 🔴 LIVE – type your answer in chat!
description:
✍️ Guess the word and type it in the LIVE CHAT – 24/7!
🔤 A new word every round: an emoji hint, then the letters appear one by one. Every 3rd round: guess the country from its flag 🏳️

HOW TO PLAY
1. Look at the emoji and the letters.
2. Type your answer in the chat. The stream runs a few seconds behind, so just type when you know it.
3. Everyone who's right scores: 1st = 10, 2nd = 7, 3rd = 5, everyone else 3 points.
4. Type your country to get your flag next to your name.

🏆 TOP PLAYERS TODAY: the best guessers of the day, live on screen.
🎱 Our other live game: the Country Marble Race – youtube.com/channel/UCG6xEYtopZcK66gz_biiIIA/live

🎵 Original music made for this channel (AI-generated).
Be kind in the chat – names are shown on stream.

#guesstheword #wordgame #livestream
